chunks.heading: Online registration and certification and transcripts
chunks.text:
Online registration and certification or 
Students can apply online through the Kathmandu University Registration and Certification Portal using their university registration number to access registration and certification services.

chunks.heading: Office visit
chunks.text:
Office visit
Students who prefer to apply in person can visit the Office of the Controller of Examinations at the Kathmandu University central campus in Dhulikhel for registration and certification services.
